plan.title: docs: accuracy audit, Overdeck Anywhere (21 pages)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Every item edits one Mintlify page in the two Overdeck Anywhere nav groups (anywhere.mdx, ten configuration/ pages, ten cli/ pages); the finalize lint counts each page as its own subsystem, so 21 pages read as many subsystems. The epic (#5467) scopes one audit issue per docs nav group, and the pages share one validation pass and one PR body, so splitting into sibling issues would duplicate the validator and PR-body work without adding review isolation.

narratives.Problem: The 21 pages in the Overdeck Anywhere docs nav groups describe features shipped in v0.64.0 to v0.74.0 as 'next release' or 'planned' (about 40 stale labels, including the known triggers note), sell add-ons that do not exist, omit Grok from the MCP harness list, misstate CLI output, error texts and limits, and lack help links and searchable titles.
narratives.Proposal: The planning session audited all 21 pages against code and recorded every finding with grep anchor, replacement text and evidence in .pan/drafts/PAN-5500.md (Appendices A to U), with planner overrides (anchor slug probe, billing wording). One docs item per page (anywhere.mdx split into three section items, linked-machines.mdx and mcp.mdx into two, chained by blocks edges because they share a file) applies the change table, the Missing bullets, the dash rule, the D4 title, the help sentence and the link check. A final item runs lint:docs and the Mintlify validators and writes the per-page PR body with Follow-ups for code bugs.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No code, test, rule, docs.json, CLAUDE.md, README.md, docs/*.md or changelog.d change; code bugs found go to the PR body's Follow-ups
- No edits to pages outside the two Overdeck Anywhere nav groups
- No new pages, navigation changes, file renames or slug changes
- No heading renames except `## Before you start` on phone.mdx (Appendix T row 2); a heading is deleted only where the PRD says so (`## What comes next` on remote-access.mdx)
- No screenshots or images added or replaced
- No changes to prices, plan limits, fee tables or competitor figures beyond the listed rows
- No claim that production billing is on or off
- No change to the `#find-your-machines-through-overdeck-ai` anchors (they resolve)

autoDecisions.summary: The page asserts neither 'billing is on' nor 'billing is off'; it uses the account page's own wording 'Paid plans are invite-only for now.'
autoDecisions.rationale: Creem billing is built but gated on CREEM_* deployment config that is not in the repo (services/account/wrangler.jsonc:30), so production state cannot be verified from code; the invite-only message is code-backed (services/account/src/account-page/page.ts:23).

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the existing #find-your-machines-through-overdeck-ai anchors and drop the rows that changed them
autoDecisions.rationale: Probe with npx mint@4.3.49 broken-links --check-anchors on a scratch site: the -overdeck-ai form resolves and the -overdeckai form is reported broken.

autoDecisions.summary: Every one of the 21 pages gets the same help sentence linking Discord and GitHub Issues
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for help links where a page talks about getting help; Anywhere pages are setup pages where failure is the common case, and one sentence keeps the group consistent.

autoDecisions.summary: Retitle 19 generic titles with a sidebarTitle keeping the old nav label; anywhere and phone keep theirs
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires specific searchable titles; PAN-5501 and PAN-5503 used the same sidebarTitle pattern.

autoDecisions.summary: Add every non-optional Missing bullet briefly; skip bullets the research marked Optional
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks to add what a user needs that is missing, kept short; Optional bullets are nice-to-have detail.
